summary: Frontend-only visual redesign of the salon admin Dashboard verified end-to-end. All 9 requested regression checks PASSED. Dashboard sparkle canvas + data-vertical=salon, aurora bg + glint layer render. Sidebar Miracurl master-brand logo block appears above the tenant brand mark on every page tested (dashboard/appointments/settings). Powered-by pills present in topbar (visible @1920, hidden @390) and sidebar footer. Mira DJ bot dances (data-dancing false→true, .mira-dancing class, 3 .mira-note spans, button toggles Play↔Stop) and returns to idle on Stop. All previously-dark cards (mira-assistant, mira-day-offer, quick-actions, low-stock, pending-approvals) now render dark text (rgb 15,23,42 / 30,41,59) — no white-on-white regressions. Day-offer <select> uses text-slate-700 with white option styling. KPI tiles render values; rating/pending-reviews/staff-performance widgets have dash-cream-card; month-revenue reveal/lock toggle present. Other admin pages (/appointments, /settings) correctly OMIT dashboard-sparkle-canvas but retain sidebar logo + powered-by pills. Mobile 390: no horizontal overflow, topbar pill hidden as expected (md:inline-flex).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Caused by instrumentation attaching x-ve-dynamic <span> wrappers inside <option> text. Console noise only — not a visual regression, but should be cleaned by wrapping option text as a plain string. Low priority.

critical_code_review_comments: MiraDayOffer.jsx line ~55: dev-instrumentation is injecting a <span> inside <option>, producing a React hydration warning. Consider ensuring option label is a raw string (e.g. `{label}` computed outside JSX children) to suppress the warning in dev builds.
reminders-widget data-testid was not found on dashboard (widget may only render conditionally) — confirm this is intentional; task spec said 'if present' so treated as pass.

If a restaurant tenant is added later, verify [data-testid=dashboard-page] has data-vertical=restaurant. YouTube embed showing 'Video unavailable' in headless is expected per spec. Passkey + What's New popups are dismissed via 'Got it ✦' and 'Not now' buttons.
